test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

TMTQ, WGCE, ZALS, CUUG, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

**First alphabet is increased by +3, second is decreased by -6, third is increased by +9 and fourth is decreased by -12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8656d1de7984ff1a01ad3a68568ee5db091e3c1f15c3a01ade56a1ea9034d270.png] 

So, **FODU will complete the series.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
